senses.gloss: (cmp. טוּחַ I) to cover with a cohesive substance, to polish (with a fatty matter); to besmear, soil, pollute.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 30b">Pes. 30ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 95b">Zeb. 95ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>אין טָשִׁין וכ׳</he> one must not polish the stove with &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 9:31">Tosef. B. Kam. IX, 31</cite> [in a misplaced passage, belonging after <he>שבידיו</he>; read:] <he>הרָק כנגד פני חבירו וטָשׁ פניו</he> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 50">Is. L</cite>, 6ᵇ) who spat into or besmeared his neighbor’s face; (cmp. Mish. ib. VIII, 6; Sifra Emor Par. 14, ch. XX).
<cite ref="Taanit 22b:19">Taan. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>מְטַשְׁטְשִׁין את הארץ</he> (the heavy rains) make the soil muddy and it yields no fruit; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 671">Yalk. Lev. 671</cite>.

senses.gloss: to smear over, besmear. Part. pass. מְטוּשְׁטָשׁ, pl. מְטוּשְׁטָשִׁין.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 65b:4">Pes. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>היו בגדיו מט׳</he> if his (the priest’s) garments were besmeared (with blood &c.); <cite ref="Zevachim 18a">Zeb. 18ᵃ</cite>, sq.; <cite ref="Zevachim 35a">ib. 35ᵃ</cite>.—
<cite ref="Megillah 18b:7">Meg. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>אותיות מְטוּשְׁטָשׁוֹת</he> letters made illegible by being smeared over.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 168b:3">B. Bath. 168ᵇ</cite> <he>נמחק או נט׳</he> if the writing was blotted out or blurred.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 4:13">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IV, 13</cite> <he>נִטַּשְׁטְשָׁה</he> a metal mirror which became blurred (blind).
<cite ref="Shabbat 81a">Sabb. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>נִיטַּשְׁטְשׁוּ</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>נשטש׳</he>, corr. acc.) the spots were washed away (became indistinct).
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:9">Cant. R. to VIII, 9</cite> a picture on a wall <he>אע״פ שמִטַּשְׁטֶשֶׁת</he> (prob. <he>שמְטוּשְׁטֶשֶׁת</he>, v. supra) even if it be smeared over.
